findings: The book says phenol and an acyl chloride produce 'an ether'; the product phenyl ethanoate is an ester.
The sodium equation on p95 is printed with one phenol on the left (unbalanced) and the phenoxide sketch on p96 omits the water formed; the redrawn figures show 2 phenol + 2Na and + H2O.
